maintenance_led.reason: Sells consumable haircare products (shampoos, conditioners, treatments) used up in normal use, not repair of installed assets.

publicly_funded.reason: Paid by consumers, salons and retailers buying haircare products; no government payer.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows by selling its own branded bond-building haircare products and launching new products, not through acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Consumer and salon haircare products can be swapped for competing brands easily, with little switching cost or disruption.
